author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,

my friend was at my house so I let him use my latptop for playing minecraft. He used his account but he has informed me that he got banned for ban evading. This is a mistake so I would appreciate it if he (Mistaa_mitraa) was unbanned.

sorry for the inconvenience,

DaCrowMan
